A0_S2_D3: ^Narrator: Now, you’ll cease to exist in records. Turned into the very kind of monster your island was blessed to be void of.
^Young Noelle: How do we escape the floods?
^Young Noelle: Does the giant monster cause floods because it’s evil?
^Mother: Which is why we never leave our Island of Dusk.
^Narrator: You’ve only seen drawings of such creatures in books; animals, as they were also called, with threatening features and the ability to speak like humans do.
^Narrator: And now… you are neither. A hybrid of the two more monstrous than the imagination.
